versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְאֶל־בָּנָ֗יו וְיִנָּֽזְרוּ֙ מִקָּדְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלֹ֥א יְחַלְּל֖וּ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֑י אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵ֧ם מַקְדִּשִׁ֛ים לִ֖י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: Dize a Arão e a seus filhos, que se abstenham das coisas santas dos filhos de Israel, e que não profanem meu santo nome no que eles me santificam: Eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם לְדֹרֹ֨תֵיכֶ֜ם כָּל־אִ֣ישׁ׀ אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרַ֣ב מִכָּל־זַרְעֲכֶ֗ם אֶל־הַקֳּדָשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְדִּ֤ישׁוּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וְטֻמְאָת֖וֹ עָלָ֑יו וְנִכְרְתָ֞ה הַנֶּ֧פֶשׁ הַהִ֛וא מִלְּפָנַ֖י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “Tell them, ‘If anyone of all your seed throughout your generations approaches the holy things, which the children of Israel make holy to Yahweh, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me. I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed among your generations, that goeth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto the Lord, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from my presence: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: Dize-lhes: Todo homem de toda vossa descendência em vossas gerações que chegar às coisas sagradas, que os filhos de Israel consagram ao SENHOR, tendo imundícia sobre si, de diante de mim será eliminada sua alma: Eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: אִ֣ישׁ אִ֞ישׁ מִזֶּ֣רַע אַהֲרֹ֗ן וְה֤וּא צָר֨וּעַ֙ א֣וֹ זָ֔ב בַּקֳּדָשִׁים֙ לֹ֣א יֹאכַ֔ל עַ֖ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִטְהָ֑ר וְהַנֹּגֵ֨עַ֙ בְּכָל־טְמֵא־נֶ֔פֶשׁ א֣וֹ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־תֵּצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֖נּוּ שִׁכְבַת־זָֽרַע׃

controles.web: “‘Whoever of the seed of Aaron is a leper or has an issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goes from him;
controles.kjv: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath a running issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth any thing that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;
controles.livre: Qualquer homem da semente de Arão que for leproso, ou padecer fluxo, não comerá das coisas sagradas até que esteja limpo: e o que tocar qualquer coisa impura de cadáver, ou o homem do qual houver saído derramamento de sêmen;

versos.hebraico: אוֹ־אִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִגַּ֔ע בְּכָל־שֶׁ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִטְמָא־ל֑וֹ א֤וֹ בְאָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִטְמָא־ל֔וֹ לְכֹ֖ל טֻמְאָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: or whoever touches any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatever uncleanness he has;
controles.kjv: Or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;
controles.livre: Ou o homem que houver tocado qualquer réptil ou inseto, pelo qual será impuro, ou homem pelo qual venha a ser impuro, conforme qualquer imundícia sua;

versos.hebraico: נֶ֚פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּגַּע־בּ֔וֹ וְטָמְאָ֖ה עַד־הָעָ֑רֶב וְלֹ֤א יֹאכַל֙ מִן־הַקֳּדָשִׁ֔ים כִּ֛י אִם־רָחַ֥ץ בְּשָׂר֖וֹ בַּמָּֽיִם׃

controles.web: the person that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he bathe his body in water.
controles.kjv: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.
controles.livre: A pessoa que o tocar, será impura até à tarde, e não comerá das coisas sagradas antes que tenha lavado sua carne com água.

versos.hebraico: וּבָ֥א הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ וְטָהֵ֑ר וְאַחַר֙ יֹאכַ֣ל מִן־הַקֳּדָשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י לַחְמ֖וֹ הֽוּא׃

controles.web: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.
controles.kjv: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean, and shall afterward eat of the holy things; because it is his food.
controles.livre: E quando o sol se puser, será limpo; e depois comerá as coisas sagradas, porque seu pão é.

versos.hebraico: נְבֵלָ֧ה וּטְרֵפָ֛ה לֹ֥א יֹאכַ֖ל לְטָמְאָה־בָ֑הּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: That which dies of itself, or is torn by animals, he shall not eat, defiling himself by it. I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: That which dieth of itself, or is torn with beasts, he shall not eat to defile himself therewith: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: O morto naturalmente nem despedaçado por fera não comerá, para contaminar-se em ele: Eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְשָׁמְר֣וּ אֶת־מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֗י וְלֹֽא־יִשְׂא֤וּ עָלָיו֙ חֵ֔טְא וּמֵ֥תוּ ב֖וֹ כִּ֣י יְחַלְּלֻ֑הוּ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃

controles.web: “‘They shall therefore follow my requirements, lest they bear sin for it, and die therein, if they profane it. I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.
controles.kjv: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, and die therefore, if they profane it: I the Lord do sanctify them.
controles.livre: Guardem, pois, minha ordenança, e não levem pecado por ele, não seja que assim morram quando a profanarem: Eu sou o SENHOR que os santifico.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־זָ֖ר לֹא־יֹ֣אכַל קֹ֑דֶשׁ תּוֹשַׁ֥ב כֹּהֵ֛ן וְשָׂכִ֖יר לֹא־יֹ֥אכַל קֹֽדֶשׁ׃

controles.web: “‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
controles.kjv: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
controles.livre: Nenhum estranho comerá coisa sagrada; o hóspede do sacerdote, nem o empregado, não comerá coisa sagrada.

versos.hebraico: וְכֹהֵ֗ן כִּֽי־יִקְנֶ֥ה נֶ֨פֶשׁ֙ קִנְיַ֣ן כַּסְפּ֔וֹ ה֖וּא יֹ֣אכַל בּ֑וֹ וִילִ֣יד בֵּית֔וֹ הֵ֖ם יֹאכְל֥וּ בְלַחְמֽוֹ׃

controles.web: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and such as are born in his house, they shall eat of his bread.
controles.kjv: But if the priest buy any soul with his money, he shall eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they shall eat of his meat.
controles.livre: Mas o sacerdote, quando comprar pessoa de seu dinheiro, esta comerá dela, e o nascido em sua casa: estes comerão de seu pão.

versos.hebraico: וּבַת־כֹּהֵ֔ן כִּ֥י תִהְיֶ֖ה לְאִ֣ישׁ זָ֑ר הִ֕וא בִּתְרוּמַ֥ת הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽל׃

controles.web: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.
controles.kjv: If the priest’s daughter also be married unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.
controles.livre: Porém a filha do sacerdote, quando se casar com homem estranho, ela não comerá da oferta das coisas sagradas.

versos.hebraico: וּבַת־כֹּהֵן֩ כִּ֨י תִהְיֶ֜ה אַלְמָנָ֣ה וּגְרוּשָׁ֗ה וְזֶרַע֮ אֵ֣ין לָהּ֒ וְשָׁבָ֞ה אֶל־בֵּ֤ית אָבִ֨יהָ֙ כִּנְעוּרֶ֔יהָ מִלֶּ֥חֶם אָבִ֖יהָ תֹּאכֵ֑ל וְכָל־זָ֖ר לֹא־יֹ֥אכַל בּֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: But if a priest’s daughter is a widow, or divorced, and has no child, and has returned to her father’s house, as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s bread: but no stranger shall eat any of it.
controles.kjv: But if the priest’s daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father’s house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father’s meat: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.
controles.livre: Porém se a filha do sacerdote for viúva, ou repudiada, e não tiver descendência, e se houver voltado à casa de seu pai, como em sua juventude, comerá do pão de seu pai; mas nenhum estranho coma dele.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּֽי־יֹאכַ֥ל קֹ֖דֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָ֑ה וְיָסַ֤ף חֲמִֽשִׁיתוֹ֙ עָלָ֔יו וְנָתַ֥ן לַכֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת־הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

controles.web: “‘If a man eats something holy unwittingly, then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it, and shall give the holy thing to the priest.
controles.kjv: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing.
controles.livre: E o que por acidente comer coisa sagrada, acrescentará a ela seu quinto, e o dará ao sacerdote com a coisa sagrada.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹ֣א יְחַלְּל֔וּ אֶת־קָדְשֵׁ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־יָרִ֖ימוּ לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to Yahweh,
controles.kjv: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto the Lord;
controles.livre: Não profanarão, pois, as coisas santas dos filhos de Israel, as quais separam para o SENHOR:

versos.hebraico: וְהִשִּׂ֤יאוּ אוֹתָם֙ עֲוֺ֣ן אַשְׁמָ֔ה בְּאָכְלָ֖ם אֶת־קָדְשֵׁיהֶ֑ם כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃פ

controles.web: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt, when they eat their holy things; for I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.’”
controles.kjv: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass, when they eat their holy things: for I the Lord do sanctify them.
controles.livre: E não lhes farão levar a iniquidade do pecado, comendo as coisas santas deles: porque eu o SENHOR sou o que os santifico.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְאֶל־בָּנָ֗יו וְאֶל֙ כָּל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אִ֣ישׁ אִישׁ֩ מִבֵּ֨ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּמִן־הַגֵּ֣ר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְרִ֤יב קָרְבָּנוֹ֙ לְכָל־נִדְרֵיהֶם֙ וּלְכָל־נִדְבוֹתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־יַקְרִ֥יבוּ לַיהוָ֖ה לְעֹלָֽה׃

controles.web: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘Whoever is of the house of Israel, or of the foreigners in Israel, who offers his offering, whether it be any of their vows, or any of their freewill offerings, which they offer to Yahweh for a burnt offering;
controles.kjv: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whatsoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto the Lord for a burnt offering;
controles.livre: Fala a Arão e a seus filhos, e a todos os filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Qualquer homem da casa de Israel, ou dos estrangeiros em Israel, que oferecer sua oferta por todos os seus votos, e por todas seus ofertas voluntárias que oferecerem ao SENHOR em holocausto.

versos.hebraico: לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֑ם תָּמִ֣ים זָכָ֔ר בַּבָּקָ֕ר בַּכְּשָׂבִ֖ים וּבָֽעִזִּֽים׃

controles.web: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without defect, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.
controles.kjv: Ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.
controles.livre: De vossa vontade oferecereis macho sem defeito dentre as vacas, dentre os cordeiros, ou dentre as cabras.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־בּ֥וֹ מ֖וּם לֹ֣א תַקְרִ֑יבוּ כִּי־לֹ֥א לְרָצ֖וֹן יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: But whatever has a defect, that you shall not offer; for it shall not be acceptable for you.
controles.kjv: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.
controles.livre: Nenhuma coisa em que tenha falta oferecereis, porque não será aceito por vós.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֗ישׁ כִּֽי־יַקְרִ֤יב זֶֽבַח־שְׁלָמִים֙ לַיהוָ֔ה לְפַלֵּא־נֶ֨דֶר֙ א֣וֹ לִנְדָבָ֔ה בַּבָּקָ֖ר א֣וֹ בַצֹּ֑אן תָּמִ֤ים יִֽהְיֶה֙ לְרָצ֔וֹן כָּל־מ֖וּם לֹ֥א יִהְיֶה־בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh to accomplish a vow, or for a freewill offering, of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted. It shall have no defect.
controles.kjv: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the Lord to accomplish his vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.
controles.livre: Também, quando alguém oferecer sacrifício pacífico ao SENHOR para presentear voto, ou oferecendo voluntariamente, seja de vacas ou de ovelhas, sem mácula será aceito; não há de haver nele falta.

versos.hebraico: עַוֶּרֶת֩ א֨וֹ שָׁב֜וּר אוֹ־חָר֣וּץ אֽוֹ־יַבֶּ֗לֶת א֤וֹ גָרָב֙ א֣וֹ יַלֶּ֔פֶת לֹא־תַקְרִ֥יבוּ אֵ֖לֶּה לַיהוָ֑ה וְאִשֶּׁ֗ה לֹא־תִתְּנ֥וּ מֵהֶ֛ם עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Blind, injured, maimed, having a wart, festering, or having a running sore: you shall not offer these to Yahweh, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto the Lord, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the Lord.
controles.livre: Cego, ou aleijado, ou mutilado, ou com verruga, ou sarnento ou com impingens, não oferecereis estes ao SENHOR, nem deles poreis oferta acesa sobre o altar do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְשׁ֥וֹר וָשֶׂ֖ה שָׂר֣וּעַ וְקָל֑וּט נְדָבָה֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹת֔וֹ וּלְנֵ֖דֶר לֹ֥א יֵרָצֶֽה׃

controles.web: Either a bull or a lamb that has any deformity or lacking in his parts, that you may offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
controles.kjv: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
controles.livre: Boi ou carneiro que tenha de mais ou de menos, poderás oferecer por oferta voluntária; mas por voto não será aceito.

versos.hebraico: וּמָע֤וּךְ וְכָתוּת֙ וְנָת֣וּק וְכָר֔וּת לֹ֥א תַקְרִ֖יבוּ לַֽיהוָ֑ה וּֽבְאַרְצְכֶ֖ם לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃

controles.web: That which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut, you shall not offer to Yahweh; neither shall you do thus in your land.
controles.kjv: Ye shall not offer unto the Lord that which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall ye make any offering thereof in your land.
controles.livre: Ferido ou golpeado, rompido ou cortado, não oferecereis ao SENHOR, nem em vossa terra o fareis.

versos.hebraico: וּמִיַּ֣ד בֶּן־נֵכָ֗ר לֹ֥א תַקְרִ֛יבוּ אֶת־לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם מִכָּל־אֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֣י מָשְׁחָתָ֤ם בָּהֶם֙ מ֣וּם בָּ֔ם לֹ֥א יֵרָצ֖וּ לָכֶֽם׃פ

controles.web: Neither shall you offer the bread of your God from the hand of a foreigner of any of these; because their corruption is in them. There is a defect in them. They shall not be accepted for you.’”
controles.kjv: Neither from a stranger’s hand shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption is in them, and blemishes be in them: they shall not be accepted for you.
controles.livre: E da mão de filho de estrangeiro não oferecereis o pão de vosso Deus de todas estas coisas; porque sua corrupção está nelas: há nelas falta, não se vos aceitarão.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: שׁ֣וֹר אוֹ־כֶ֤שֶׂב אוֹ־עֵז֙ כִּ֣י יִוָּלֵ֔ד וְהָיָ֛ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים תַּ֣חַת אִמּ֑וֹ וּמִיּ֤וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי֙ וָהָ֔לְאָה יֵרָצֶ֕ה לְקָרְבַּ֥ן אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “When a bull, or a sheep, or a goat, is born, then it shall remain seven days with its mother; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the Lord.
controles.livre: O boi, ou o cordeiro, ou a cabra, quando nascer, sete dias estará mamando de sua mãe: mas desde o oitavo dia em adiante será aceito para oferta de sacrifício acendido ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְשׁ֖וֹר אוֹ־שֶׂ֑ה אֹת֣וֹ וְאֶת־בְּנ֔וֹ לֹ֥א תִשְׁחֲט֖וּ בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.
controles.kjv: And whether it be cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day.
controles.livre: E seja boi ou carneiro, não degolareis em um dia a o e a seu filho.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־תִזְבְּח֥וּ זֶֽבַח־תּוֹדָ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֖ם תִּזְבָּֽחוּ׃

controles.web: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to Yahweh, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.
controles.kjv: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the Lord, offer it at your own will.
controles.livre: E quando sacrificardes sacrifício de ação de graças ao SENHOR, de vossa vontade o sacrificareis.

versos.hebraico: בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ יֵאָכֵ֔ל לֹֽא־תוֹתִ֥ירוּ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַד־בֹּ֑קֶר אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning. I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: On the same day it shall be eaten up; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: No mesmo dia se comerá; não deixareis dele para outro dia: Eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ מִצְוֺתַ֔י וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: Guardai pois meus mandamentos, e executai-os: Eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹ֤א תְחַלְּלוּ֙ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֔י וְנִ֨קְדַּשְׁתִּ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם׃

controles.web: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am Yahweh who makes you holy,
controles.kjv: Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am the Lord which hallow you,
controles.livre: E não profaneis meu santo nome, e eu me santificarei em meio dos filhos de Israel: Eu sou o SENHOR que vos santifico;

versos.hebraico: הַמּוֹצִ֤יא אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִהְי֥וֹת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃פ

controles.web: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I am Yahweh.”
controles.kjv: That brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: Que vos tirei da terra do Egito, para ser vosso Deus: Eu sou o SENHOR.
